name: Online Discussion Representation Benchmark
description: An evaluation benchmark for models that produce representations of online discussions, measuring downstream performance on tasks such as thread retrieval, clustering, and moderation.
evaluation_method: task-specific metrics (e.g., retrieval metrics such as MAP / Recall@k, clustering metrics such as ARI / NMI, and classification metrics such as F1)
general_score_metric: task-dependent (commonly F1 for moderation and MAP / Recall@k for retrieval)
reputation: A niche but useful academic benchmark in social computing for evaluating discussion representations; moderately used in related research.
notes: Evaluation focuses on representation quality rather than end-to-end LLM generation; dataset and tasks are domain-specific to online discussions and may have annotation/noise and privacy considerations. Scores vary substantially by task.
